message:
Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Reproduce and fix OSS-Fuzz issue 6424351550210048 in HarfBuzz - a use-of-uninitialized-value bug in `merge_out_clusters` called from `reorder_marks_arabic` during Arabic text shaping. Need to craft a PoC input file for the fuzzer.

COMPLETED:
- Built fuzzer driver `/tmp/hb-fuzzer` (compiled hb-fuzzer.cc with main wrapper)
- Examined fuzzer harness: reads last 64 bytes of input as 16 UTF-32 code points, shapes with Arabic font
- Identified vulnerable code path: `reorder_marks_arabic` → `merge_out_clusters(start, j)` reads `out_info[start..j-1]` where indices are into decomposed buffer but `out_info`/`out_len` hold pre-decomposition data
- Root cause: after `swap_buffers()`, `out_info` points to pre-decomposition buffer with `out_len` = pre-decomposition length; if decomposition increases glyph count, `j` can exceed `out_len` causing uninitialized read
- Installed valgrind (`/usr/bin/valgrind`) for detecting uninitialized reads
- Confirmed Arabic test font: `test/shaping/fonts/sha1sum/24b8d24d00ae86f49791b746da4c9d3f717a51a8.ttf` (11264 bytes, last 64 bytes all zeros)
- Examined test case text: U+0628,U+0618,U+0619,U+064E,U+064F,U+0654,U+0658,U+0653,U+0654,U+0651,U+0656,U+0651,U+065C,U+0655,U+0650 (15 code points)

PENDING:
- Craft PoC input: need a character that decomposes into multiple glyphs (increasing count) combined with Arabic marks to trigger `reorder_marks_arabic`
- Create PoC font file by replacing last 64 bytes with UTF-32 text
- Run under valgrind to confirm uninitialized read
- Develop and apply fix

CURRENT_STATE:
- Working dir: `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz`
- Fuzzer binary: `/tmp/hb-fuzzer` (built, 3.7MB)
- Valgrind installed at `/usr/bin/valgrind`
- Shell currently stuck (previous apt-get command still running, need to wait or interrupt)
- Key files examined:
  - `src/hb-ot-shape-complex-arabic.cc` (reorder_marks_arabic)
  - `src/hb-ot-shape-normalize.cc` (normalize flow)
  - `src/hb-buffer.cc` (merge_out_clusters, swap_buffers)
  - `src/hb-buffer-private.hh` (buffer structure)

CODE_STATE:
- Vulnerable function: `hb_buffer_t::merge_out_clusters(unsigned int start, unsigned int end)` in `src/hb-buffer.cc`
- Called from: `reorder_marks_arabic()` in `src/hb-ot-shape-complex-arabic.cc`
- Buffer mechanics: after `swap_buffers()`, `info`=decomposed buffer, `out_info`=pre-decomposition buffer, `len`=decomposed length, `out_len`=pre-decomposition length
- Bug trigger: decomposition increases glyph count so `j` (index into decomposed buffer) exceeds `out_len`

TESTS:
- No failing tests yet; need to create PoC and verify with valgrind
- Test font available: `test/shaping/fonts/sha1sum/24b8d24d00ae86f49791b746da4c9d3f717a51a8.ttf`

CHANGES:
- No code changes yet
- Created `/tmp/hb_main.cc` (fuzzer driver main wrapper)

DEPS:
- harfbuzz-fuzzing, harfbuzz, glib-2.0, pthread
- valgrind installed for debugging

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS:
- No git history available in repo
- Working on vulnerable version of HarfBuzz
